focus: Molten 70s lava-lamp lettering for Odd little club

studies.name: Slow melt
studies.note: Swollen f hooks, soft pinched joins and rounded counters give the wordmark a molten 70s rhythm. A few tentacle cuts echo the Nasties.
studies.refine: Open the n and o counters for small sizes and balance the two f ascenders.
studies.brief: The calmest, strongest brand candidate. Seven distinct but closely fitted lowercase letters with BIG plump ballooning bowls and soft pinched waists, molten liquid f ascenders with oversized rounded teardrop hooks, a slightly squashed oval o, heavy blob-ended k arms. The whole word has a subtly undulating baseline and beautiful 1970s optical rhythm. Start from reference 1's chunky playful identity but substantially push the letter contours into liquid lava-lamp silhouettes. Animal integration is extremely restrained: a single elegantly curling tentacle-like gap at each f crossbar and only 2 or 3 enlarged sucker-shaped cuts on ONE f. Mostly solid navy silhouette, easy to read. No print filling.
studies.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: 1024x1024 square logo exploration board for Finfolk.
Primary request: lean strongly into a LAVA-LAMP 1970s typographic concept for "Odd little club", integrating the established quirky marine animal motifs into the custom lettering.
References: image 1 is the selected wordmark's starting personality, image 2 is its tentacle lettering experiment, image 3 is the established animal motif language. Use these as creative references, not fixed letter contours.
Style: original sophisticated high-fashion psychedelic 70s typography. Visibly molten, chunky, bulbous, sinuous, playful, organic. Smooth crisp flat shapes and impeccable optical spacing. Animal forms guide the contour, negative space and rhythm. The hero is the lettering itself.
Composition: warm ivory background. Upper two-thirds a huge SINGLE LINE wordmark reading EXACTLY "finfolk" (seven letters: f i n f o l k), in flat deep navy #172440. Comfortable margins and no clipped edges. Below the large wordmark a small lowercase "ff" extracted from the same two f designs. Bottom row three smaller samples: navy on ivory, ivory on navy, and hot pink plus cobalt on acid yellow. Only the text "finfolk" and "ff". No headings or labels.
Avoid: standard serif wordmark with decorative print pasted inside, generic Cooper Black, thin delicate lines, clutter, decorative frame, standalone animals, 3D, gradients, shiny bubbles, actual lava-lamp object, background patterns, shadows, photographic texture, extra words. The brand is for freediving and training, no spearfishing.

Start from reference 1's chunky playful identity but substantially push the letter contours into liquid lava-lamp silhouettes. studies.name: Liquid ligatures
studies.note: Letters swell and share soft joins, turning the word into one flowing form with animal-shaped spaces between the strokes.
studies.refine: Keep the i and the second f distinct where the strokes meet; simplify the shared cuts for small uses.
studies.brief: A MORE CONNECTED bespoke lowercase finfolk wordmark. Thick flowing liquid letters fuse at a few points like separate blobs touching inside a lava lamp: the first f and i almost touch around one tentacle-shaped ivory channel, n and second f share a soft organic join, f and o share a smooth narrow curved ivory seam. EVERY letter remains legible and the i retains a distinct floating blob dot. All seven lowercase letters spell finfolk. Give the o a soft off-centre organic bean-shaped counter. k arms are rounded flowing fin lobes, not straight strokes. Sophisticated controlled negative space in deep solid navy, with a few broad jellyfish-like trailing cutouts INSIDE the second f's crossbar. Genuinely redraw the silhouettes into a molten 70s typographic ligature, not a standard font with illustrations added.

studies.name: After hours
studies.note: A bolder display treatment with bulbous letterforms, drifting dots and tentacle-like terminals, for the loudest brand moments.
studies.refine: Keep a solid companion for small UI uses and resolve any f / s ambiguity in the final drawing.
studies.brief: The most exuberant high-fashion 70s display direction. Huge thick puffy soft psychedelic lowercase finfolk letters, tall f ascenders curve into bulbous drooping lava blobs, slight alternating letter tilts, plump pinch-waisted stems, a heavy low-slung o, an irregular oval i dot hovering slightly offset. Broad sweeping tentacle-shaped terminal on the k and fin-like flared feet give the animal language through the actual letter outline. Confident unconventional proportions, voluptuous curves, a soft surreal fashion-club identity. A FEW large ivory oval sucker marks integrated selectively into the f hooks, not an all-over decorated font. The letters are newly drawn and not identical to reference 1. Keep clean legibility and clearly spell finfolk. FF monogram is simply the same two lowercase f forms, one upright one slightly leaning. No extra objects, icons or animals outside the word.
